title: Birdman Names Lil Wayne's Only Verzuz Opponent
htmlContent:
Cash Money Co-Founder Birdman was a guest on the Big Facts podcast earlier this week. During his appearance, he asked many questions, including who he thought Lil Wayne's opponent should be in a Verzuz battle.

"Himself, Wayne versus Tunechi," Birdman said, which drew a laugh from the co-hosts. "He got too much shit going on, he don't need to touch that. Come on, brother, this is Tunechi. This n-gga had 100 singles in one year. He passed Elvis Presley in one year. 100 songs on Billboard, so I don't think an individual could top that. The work Wayne put into it, I wouldn't even play with that shit."

Birdman would go on to say that don't expect 'The Carter' artist to participate in any upcoming Verzuz match up,
